ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.15:0.85 ratio of high-intensity (white/light-grey) to low-intensity (dark charcoal/black) pixels across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniformly dark-pixel background interspersed with high-frequency distribution of small (5-15 pixel diameter) high-intensity annular and circular blobs; density of white blobs increases significantly at the lateral extremities of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central notch with an estimated internal angle of 65 degrees; depth is approximately 15% of the visible lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular boundary with stochastic peak-to-valley variations (amplitude 3-8 pixels); serration is present along the entire trailing edge from notch to distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobes exhibit symmetrical lateral sweep; trailing edges follow a complex curve with overall convexity, while leading edges (partially obscured) suggest a tapered sweep towards the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive mapping of circular/annular white pixel clusters (rings) across the ventral surface; highest spatial density located on the distal-lateral quadrants of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, non-parallel light-grey linear streaks visible on the lower-medial sections of both lobes near the water line.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized cluster of high-intensity, textured protrusions on the far-left distal tip, consistent with active barnacle colonization; irregular missing pixel-segment (notch) on the right lobe trailing edge distal margin.
